create_phimoe_config: create a PhimoeConfig instance for the Phi-3.5-MoE model with default hyperparameters
load_phimoe_config: load a PhimoeConfig from the microsoft/Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct checkpoint using from_pretrained
build_phimoe_model: build a PhimoeModel instance from a PhimoeConfig configuration object
validate_rope_parameters: validate the rope_parameters field in PhimoeConfig ensuring short_mscale and long_mscale are numbers
configure_moe_experts: configure MoE-specific parameters including num_experts_per_tok, num_local_experts, and router_aux_loss_coef
